questions.question: At the Feast of Dedication, Jesus told the Jews that something testified on His behalf. What was it?

answers.text: The works He did in His Father’s name
The crowds who followed Him everywhere
The priests who served in the temple

questions.question: Jesus said His sheep will never perish. What did He say no one can do to them?

answers.text: Snatch them out of His hand
Make them grow tired or weak
Keep them from hearing His voice

questions.question: When Jesus said that He and the Father are one, what did the Jews do?

answers.text: They picked up stones to stone Him
They bowed down and worshiped Him
They turned and walked away from Him
